Episodes.Actors: Bryan Cranston, Anna Gunn, Aaron Paul
Episodes.Plot: Walter tries to repair his fractured home life, but his actions only push Skyler further away. Meanwhile, Jesse makes a fresh start, and a new threat quietly looms over Albuquerque.

Episodes.Plot: Walt presses back into the family home, pushing Skyler toward a pivotal decision, while Jesse charts his own course as unseen threats draw closer.

Episodes.Plot: Walter spirals out of control as Skyler's actions push him to his breaking point. Meanwhile, Jesse seizes an opportunity, and tensions rise within the drug trade.

Episodes.Plot: Walt weighs a lucrative proposal as Skyler reevaluates their future, Jesse rebuilds his operation, and Hank's pursuit of the blue meth network intensifies.

Episodes.Actors: Bryan Cranston, Anna Gunn, Aaron Paul
Episodes.Plot: Walt starts work in a new lab with an assistant, while Hank's search for Heisenberg closes in on an old RV, setting in motion a tense cat-and-mouse at a scrapyard.

Episodes.Actors: Bryan Cranston, Anna Gunn, Aaron Paul
Episodes.Plot: Jesse ends up in the hospital after getting beaten up by Hank. Now he is threatening to press charges against the DEA. To stop him, Walt decides to bring Jesse on as his partner, once again.

Episodes.Title: Kafkaesque
Episodes.Plot: As mounting medical bills strain the family, Skyler devises a plan; Walt and Gus find tentative common ground, and Jesse seeks independence through a new opportunity.

Episodes.Plot: As Skyler becomes more involved in Walter's operation, she takes a calculated risk. Meanwhile, Jesse finds himself drawn back into a dangerous world, and tensions within the cartel escalate.

Episodes.Writer: Vince Gilligan, Sam Catlin, Peter Gould
Episodes.Actors: Bryan Cranston, Anna Gunn, Aaron Paul
Episodes.Plot: Against Walt's advice, Jesse lashes out. Fearing for Jesse's safety, Walt takes drastic action to intervene. Meanwhile a tragic event leads to a shocking confrontation.
